dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Wernicke's encephalopathy due to thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency precipitated by maintenance hemodialysis
Uremic encephalopathy (could account for the lentiform fork sign and altered mental status, but does not typically affect the mammillary bodies and periaqueductal gray)
Osmotic demyelination syndrome (extrapontine myelinolysis from rapid osmotic shifts during dialysis can affect the basal ganglia and thalami, but the mammillary body involvement is atypical)
Deep cerebral venous sinus thrombosis (can cause bilateral symmetric thalamic edema, but the specific periaqueductal and mammillary body involvement makes this less likely)
